before.title: FAP CAR-T cell therapy for canine soft tissue sarcoma
before.center: Tufts Cummings School of Veterinary Medicine
before.status: Actively recruiting — confirmed on the institution’s current clinical-trials page
before.funding: 🟡 Partially funded. The study covers FAP CAR-T cancer treatment through Day 56, provides $2,000 toward tumor removal, and covers treatment of side effects related to biopsy, cyclophosphamide and FAP CAR-T administration; unrelated care is owner-paid.
before.notes: Dogs need a 2-8 cm soft tissue sarcoma, resectable or non-resectable, adequate CBC/chemistry/urinalysis and no incompatible major heart, liver or kidney disease. Untreated tumors and recurrent tumors after chemotherapy and/or radiation may qualify; chemotherapy must have ended at least 14 days before enrollment. Excludes metastatic disease predicting survival under three months, concurrent experimental cancer therapy, pregnancy/lactation, autoimmune disease other than atopic dermatitis, prior monoclonal checkpoint inhibitor such as gilvetmab, or personalized T-cell vaccine/immunotherapy.
